name: sglang-disagg
about: SGLang disaggregated stack: the SGLang release image per architecture, sglang-router, and MoRI 158c7e8 on gfx942 (gfx950's image ships the MoRI it needs).

mori.why: gfx942 only (INSTALL_MORI=auto); installed editable in the image's /sgl-workspace/mori. No dma-buf fallback (see mori#721).
